name: youtube_music_find_song_artist
intent: Find the artist of a song in YouTube Music
description: Searches YouTube Music for a requested song, opens the Songs results, and reports the artist of the first song result.
patterns: search for a song and tell me the artist
who sings this song in YouTube Music
find the artist of the first song result

inputs.name: song_title
inputs.description: The song title to search for

steps.intent: Open the song results to read the artist of the first song result
